lines: state within; then outside by distinctness;
intending reabsorption, forms the doubt that
obstructs it and grasps it; the doubt-portion he
constructs in self by reabsorption; then
as own-nature; then, in that construction, some
expanded form too — thus these twelve Goddess-
simultaneously or in order, two-wise, three-wise,
order, within by pot-cloth order too, shining,

reads_against.argmap: What is the twelve-fold saṃvit-kalana? → The twelve-fold kalana is saṃvid's full constructive cycle (in→out→doubt→reabsorb→knower-forms→expanded form), operating wheel-wise at cosmic and domestic scales — Śrīkālī is its name.
c1_essence: The twelve-fold saṃvit-kalana runs the full constructive cycle — twelve Goddesses, wheel-revolving, cosmic and domestic scales, nourishing cakreśvara-svātantrya: Śrīkālī.
